text.insert: ), takes a shot at four moments. Its queue holds one request, and the latest request wins.
It takes one when the capture starts, and when the top window or its title changes in the window log of a Screen or Area capture.
It takes one 300 ms after a click or a mark, so the window can settle.

A paused recording takes none, and resuming takes one at once. Annotator's own windows are never read.
